kind: accumulated re-run on the current build: two invented languages of about 22,000 words each, taught one after the other into one learner, the second teach starting from the first's published checkpoint
units: nats, next-token cross-entropy; contamination is the fraction of answers in one language that contain material from the other

retention.probe: language-1 text, after language 2 was taught
retention.reading: negative means the first language was retained

generation.note: lexicon hit and morphological validity on eight prompts per language, greedy and at temperature 0.9

comparator.what: a low-rank adapter of matched trainable size, given the same bytes in the same order

note: Per-language fluency at this dose is modest. These runs show accumulation without erasure rather than eloquence.
